snippet.title: IMP Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
IMP Teaser Trailer - “You are an Imperial Marine Patrol, tasked with the grim duty of eradicating the alien filth that infests the exo-planetary oil refineries. With every successful extermination, you will be rewarded. Failure will not be tolerated. Only the worthy shall amass great wealth and prestige to rise in the ranks of the IMP.”
